document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    // Dropdown toggle
    const trigger = document.getElementById("profileTrigger");
    const menu = document.getElementById("dropdownMenu");

    if (trigger && menu) {
        trigger.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            menu.classList.toggle("show");
        });
    }

    // Close dropdown when clicking outside
    window.addEventListener("click", function (event) {

        if (!event.target.closest(".user-profile-widget")) {

            const dropdowns =
                document.getElementsByClassName("dropdown-menu");

            for (let i = 0; i < dropdowns.length; i++) {

                let openDropdown = dropdowns[i];

                if (openDropdown.classList.contains("show")) {
                    openDropdown.classList.remove("show");
                }

            }

        }

    });

    // About section IntersectionObserver
    const aboutSection = document.querySelector('#about');
    const aboutNavLink = document.querySelector('a[href="#about"]');

    if (aboutSection && aboutNavLink) {

        const observerOptions = {
            root: null,
            threshold: 0.6
        };

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {

            entries.forEach(entry => {

                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    aboutNavLink.classList.add('active-link');
                } else {
                    aboutNavLink.classList.remove('active-link');
                }

            });

        }, observerOptions);

        observer.observe(aboutSection);

    }

    // Show/hide elements based on auth state
    if (document.body.classList.contains("logged-in")) {

        document.querySelectorAll(".guest-only")
            .forEach(el => el.style.display = "none");

    } else {

        document.querySelectorAll(".auth-only")
            .forEach(el => el.style.display = "none");

    }

    // Profile image fallback
    const profileImages =
        document.querySelectorAll('.user-photo-img');

    profileImages.forEach(img => {

        img.onerror = function () {

            const container = this.parentElement;

            container.innerHTML =
                '<span class="material-symbols-outlined icon-placeholder">account_circle</span>';

            const placeholder =
                container.querySelector('.icon-placeholder');

            if (!placeholder) return;

            if (container.classList.contains('profile-avatar-large')) {
                placeholder.style.fontSize = "100px";
            } else {
                placeholder.style.fontSize = "38px";
            }

        };

    });

});

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {

    // Modal Elements
    const rentalButtons =
        document.querySelectorAll('.open-rental-btn');

    const modal =
        document.getElementById('rentalModal');

    const form =
        document.getElementById('quickRentalForm');

    const modalName =
        document.getElementById('modalProductName');

    const modalPeriod =
        document.getElementById('modalRentPeriod');

    const viewDetailsLink =
        document.getElementById('viewDetailsLink');

    const startDateInput =
        document.getElementById('startDateInput');

    const closeModalX =
        document.getElementById('closeModalX');

    const closeModalBtn =
        document.getElementById('closeModalBtn');

    /* ----------------------------------------------
        OPEN MODAL
    ---------------------------------------------- */
    rentalButtons.forEach(btn => {

        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {

            // Product Data
            const productId = btn.dataset.id;
            const productName = btn.dataset.name;
            const rentPeriod = btn.dataset.period;
            const detailsUrl = btn.dataset.detailsUrl;
            const cartUrl = btn.dataset.cartUrl;

            // Set Product Name
            if (modalName) {
                modalName.textContent = productName;
            }

            // Set Rental Period
            if (modalPeriod) {
                modalPeriod.textContent = rentPeriod;
            }

            // Set Details Link
            if (viewDetailsLink && detailsUrl) {
                viewDetailsLink.href = detailsUrl;
            }

            // Set Form Action
            if (form && cartUrl) {

                form.action = cartUrl;

            } else if (form && productId) {

                form.action = `/add-to-cart/${productId}`;

            }

            // Default Date = Today
            if (startDateInput) {

                const today =
                    new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

                startDateInput.value = today;

            }

            // Show Modal
            if (modal) {
                modal.style.display = 'flex';
            }

        });

    });

    /* ----------------------------------------------
        CLOSE MODAL
    ---------------------------------------------- */
    function closeRentalModal() {

        if (modal) {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
        }

    }

    // Close via X
    if (closeModalX) {
        closeModalX.addEventListener(
            'click',
            closeRentalModal
        );
    }

    // Close via Cancel
    if (closeModalBtn) {
        closeModalBtn.addEventListener(
            'click',
            closeRentalModal
        );
    }

    // Close when clicking overlay
    if (modal) {

        modal.addEventListener('click', function (e) {

            if (e.target === modal) {
                closeRentalModal();
            }

        });

    }

    // Close on ESC
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {

        if (
            e.key === 'Escape' &&
            modal &&
            modal.style.display === 'flex'
        ) {
            closeRentalModal();
        }

    });

});


/* --------------------------------------------------
    PRODUCT FILTERING / CATEGORY TABS
-------------------------------------------------- */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {

    const tabButtons =
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');

    const searchInput =
        document.getElementById('productSearch');

    const sortSelect =
        document.getElementById('sortOrder');

    /* ----------------------------------------------
        REDIRECT HELPER
    ---------------------------------------------- */
    function redirectProducts(category, search, sort) {

        const params = new URLSearchParams();

        if (category && category !== 'All') {
            params.set('category', category);
        }

        if (search && search.trim() !== '') {
            params.set('search', search.trim());
        }

        if (sort && sort !== 'default') {
            params.set('sort', sort);
        }

        const finalUrl = params.toString()
            ? `${PRODUCTS_ROUTE}?${params.toString()}`
            : PRODUCTS_ROUTE;

        window.location.href = finalUrl;

    }

    /* ----------------------------------------------
        CATEGORY TAB CLICK
    ---------------------------------------------- */
    tabButtons.forEach(button => {

        button.addEventListener('click', function () {

            // Remove active from all tabs
            tabButtons.forEach(tab => {
                tab.classList.remove('active');
            });

            // Add active to clicked
            this.classList.add('active');

            // Values
            const category =
                this.dataset.cat || 'All';

            const search =
                searchInput ? searchInput.value : '';

            const sort =
                sortSelect ? sortSelect.value : 'default';

            redirectProducts(category, search, sort);

        });

    });

    /* ----------------------------------------------
        SEARCH INPUT
    ---------------------------------------------- */
    if (searchInput) {

        let searchTimeout;

        searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {

            clearTimeout(searchTimeout);

            searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {

                const activeTab =
                    document.querySelector('.tab-btn.active');

                const category =
                    activeTab
                        ? activeTab.dataset.cat
                        : 'All';

                const search = this.value || '';

                const sort =
                    sortSelect
                        ? sortSelect.value
                        : 'default';

                redirectProducts(category, search, sort);

            }, 400);

        });

    }

    /* ----------------------------------------------
        SORT SELECT
    ---------------------------------------------- */
    if (sortSelect) {

        sortSelect.addEventListener('change', function () {

            const activeTab =
                document.querySelector('.tab-btn.active');

            const category =
                activeTab
                    ? activeTab.dataset.cat
                    : 'All';

            const search =
                searchInput
                    ? searchInput.value
                    : '';

            const sort =
                this.value || 'default';

            redirectProducts(category, search, sort);

        });

    }

});

#### FILE: static\js\users\profile.js
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    // --- Elements ---
    const editModal = document.getElementById('editModal');
    const passModal = document.getElementById('passwordModal');
    const initialImageHTML = document.getElementById('imagePreview')?.innerHTML;
    
    // Updated IDs to match your new HTML
    const profileInput = document.getElementById('profile_path'); 
    const removePhotoInput = document.getElementById('removePhotoInput');
    const removePhotoBtn = document.getElementById('removePhotoBtn');
    
    const dropdownMenu = document.getElementById('dropdownMenu');

    // Password modal elements
    const newPass = document.getElementById('new_password');
    const confirmPass = document.getElementById('confirm_password');
    const currentPass = document.getElementById('current_password');
    const matchMsg = document.getElementById('match-message');
    const passwordSaveBtn = document.querySelector('#passwordModal .btn-save');
    const passwordForm = passModal?.querySelector("form");

    // --- Create per-field error elements ---
    ['current_password', 'new_password', 'confirm_password'].forEach(id => {
        const inputEl = document.getElementById(id);
        if(inputEl && !document.getElementById(`error_${id}`)) {
            const errorDiv = document.createElement('div');
            errorDiv.id = `error_${id}`;
            errorDiv.className = 'error-msg';
            inputEl.parentElement.parentElement.appendChild(errorDiv);
        }
    });

    // Profile modal submit button
    const submitBtn = document.getElementById('saveProfileBtn');
    const btnText = document.getElementById('btnText');

    // --- Modal Open/Close ---
    const openModal = () => { 
        editModal?.classList.add('active'); 
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; 
    };
    const closeModal = () => { 
        resetProfileModal();
        editModal?.classList.remove('active'); 
        document.body.style.overflow = 'auto'; 
    };
    const openPassModal = () => { 
        passModal?.classList.add('active'); 
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; 
    };
    const closePassModal = () => { 
        passModal?.classList.remove('active'); 
        document.body.style.overflow = 'auto'; 

        [newPass, confirmPass, currentPass].forEach(el => { 
            if(el) el.value = ""; 
        });

        if(matchMsg) { 
            matchMsg.textContent = ""; 
            matchMsg.style.opacity = "0"; 
        }

        if(passwordSaveBtn) passwordSaveBtn.disabled = false;

        // Clear all per-field errors
        ['current_password', 'new_password', 'confirm_password'].forEach(id => {
            const err = document.getElementById(`error_${id}`);
            if(err) err.textContent = "";
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('#passwordModal .toggle-password').forEach(icon => {
            const targetId = icon.getAttribute('data-target');
            const input = document.getElementById(targetId);

            if (input) {
                input.type = "password";
            }

            icon.classList.remove('fa-eye');
            icon.classList.add('fa-eye-slash');
        });
    };

    // --- Reset Profile Modal ---
    const resetProfileModal = () => {
        const form = document.querySelector(".modal-form");

        if (form) {
            form.reset(); 
        }

        // reset hidden fields
        if (profileInput) profileInput.value = "";
        if (removePhotoInput) removePhotoInput.value = "false";

        // reset image preview
        const preview = document.getElementById('imagePreview');
        if (preview && initialImageHTML) {
            preview.innerHTML = initialImageHTML;
        }

        // reset submit state
        if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;
    };

    // --- Event Listeners for Modal Open ---
    document.getElementById('editProfileBtn')?.addEventListener('click', openModal);
    document.getElementById('openPassBtn')?.addEventListener('click', openPassModal);

    // Close buttons and cancel buttons
    document.querySelectorAll('.close-modal-trigger, .btn-cancel').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            closeModal();
            closePassModal();
        });
    });


    // --- Dropdown toggle ---
    document.getElementById("profileTrigger")?.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        dropdownMenu?.classList.toggle('show');
    });

    // --- Password validation ---
    const validatePasswordMatch = () => {
        if (!confirmPass || confirmPass.value.length === 0) {
            if(matchMsg) { matchMsg.textContent = ""; matchMsg.style.opacity = "0"; }
            if(passwordSaveBtn) passwordSaveBtn.disabled = false;
            return;
        }
        matchMsg.style.opacity = "1"; 
        if (newPass.value === confirmPass.value) {
            matchMsg.textContent = "? Passwords match";
            matchMsg.style.color = "#10b981";
            passwordSaveBtn.disabled = false;
        } else {
            matchMsg.textContent = "? Passwords do not match";
            matchMsg.style.color = "#ef4444";
            passwordSaveBtn.disabled = true;
        }
    };
    newPass?.addEventListener('keyup', validatePasswordMatch);
    confirmPass?.addEventListener('keyup', validatePasswordMatch);

    // --- Password visibility toggle ---
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-password').forEach(icon => {
        icon.addEventListener('click', function() {
            const targetId = this.getAttribute('data-target');
            const input = document.getElementById(targetId);
            if (input && input.type === "password") {
                input.type = "text";
                this.classList.replace('fa-eye-slash', 'fa-eye');
            } else if (input) {
                input.type = "password";
                this.classList.replace('fa-eye', 'fa-eye-slash');
            }
        });
    });

    // --- Image Preview & Remove (Refined for new UI) ---
    profileInput?.addEventListener('change', function() {
        if (this.files && this.files[0]) {
            if (removePhotoInput) removePhotoInput.value = "false";
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = (e) => {
                document.getElementById('imagePreview').innerHTML = `<img src="${e.target.result}" class="user-photo-img">`;
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(this.files[0]);
            checkChanges(); // Trigger change check
        }
    });

    removePhotoBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (confirm("Are you sure you want to remove your profile photo? This cannot be undone.")) {
            if (removePhotoInput) removePhotoInput.value = "true";
            if (profileInput) profileInput.value = "";
            
            const iconHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined icon-placeholder">account_circle</span>';
            
            // Update all preview containers
            ['imagePreview', 'navAvatarContainer', 'mobileAvatarContainer', 'sidebarAvatarContainer'].forEach(id => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.innerHTML = iconHTML;
            });
            
            if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false; // Enable save to commit the removal
        }
    });

    // --- Enable submit on changes ---
    const form = document.querySelector(".modal-form");
    
    const checkChanges = () => {
        if (!form || !submitBtn) return;
        const inputs = form.querySelectorAll("input, textarea, select");
        let changed = false;
        
        inputs.forEach(input => {
            if (input.type === "file" && input.files.length > 0) changed = true;
            else if (input.id === "removePhotoInput" && input.value === "true") changed = true;
            else if (input.defaultValue !== undefined && input.value !== input.defaultValue) changed = true;
        });
        
        submitBtn.disabled = !changed;
    };

    if (form && submitBtn) {
        form.querySelectorAll("input, textarea, select").forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener("input", checkChanges);
        });
    }

    // --- Profile submit with AJAX and Toast ---
    const profileForm = document.querySelector(".modal-form");

    profileForm?.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        
        const saveBtn = document.getElementById('saveProfileBtn');
        saveBtn.disabled = true;
        const originalText = saveBtn.innerText;
        saveBtn.innerText = "Updating...";

        const formData = new FormData(this);
        formData.append('submit_profile', 'true'); 

        fetch(this.action, { 
            method: "POST", 
            body: formData,
            headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
        })
        .then(res => {
            const contentType = res.headers.get("content-type");
            if (contentType && contentType.indexOf("application/json") !== -1) {
                return res.json();
            } else {
                throw new TypeError("Oops, we haven't got JSON!");
            }
        })
        .then(data => {
            if(data.status === "success") {
                closeModal();
                showToast(data.message, "success");
                setTimeout(() => { location.reload(); }, 1500);
            } else {
                showToast(data.message || "Update failed", "error");
            }
        })
        .catch(err => {
            console.error("Error:", err);
            showToast("An error occurred.", "error");
        })
        .finally(() => {
            saveBtn.disabled = false;
            saveBtn.innerText = originalText;
        });
    });

    // --- Password modal AJAX submission ---
    passwordForm?.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if(!passwordSaveBtn) return;

        passwordSaveBtn.disabled = true;
        const originalText = passwordSaveBtn.innerText;
        passwordSaveBtn.innerText = "Saving...";

        // Clear previous errors
        ['current_password', 'new_password', 'confirm_password'].forEach(id => {
            const err = document.getElementById(`error_${id}`);
            if(err) err.textContent = "";
        });

        const formData = new FormData(passwordForm);
        fetch(passwordForm.action, { method: "POST", body: formData })
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                if(data.status === "success") {
                    passwordForm.reset();
                    if(matchMsg) matchMsg.textContent = "";
                    closePassModal(); 
                    showToast(data.message, "success"); 
                } else if(data.status === "error") {
                    if(data.errors) {
                        Object.keys(data.errors).forEach(field => {
                            const errEl = document.getElementById(`error_${field}`);
                            if(errEl) errEl.textContent = data.errors[field][0];
                        });
                    }
                }
            })
            .catch(err => { console.error(err); })
            .finally(() => {
                passwordSaveBtn.disabled = false;
                passwordSaveBtn.innerText = originalText;
            });
    });
});

function showToast(message, type="success") {
    const toast = document.getElementById("toast");
    if (!toast) return;
    toast.textContent = message;
    toast.style.background = type === "success" ? "#10b981" : "#ef4444";
    toast.classList.add("show");
    setTimeout(() => { toast.classList.remove("show"); }, 3000);
}

    <!-- Flash auto-dismiss (runs on every page) -->
    <script nonce="{{ csp_nonce() }}">
    (function () {
        const DISMISS_AFTER = 3000; // ms before auto-dismiss starts

        function dismissBar(bar) {
            if (bar.classList.contains('dismissing')) return;
            bar.classList.add('dismissing');
            bar.addEventListener('animationend', function handler() {
                bar.removeEventListener('animationend', handler);
                bar.remove();
                // Remove wrapper if empty
                const wrapper = document.getElementById('flash-wrapper');
                if (wrapper && !wrapper.querySelector('.flash-bar')) wrapper.remove();
            });
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.flash-bar').forEach(function (bar) {
            // Manual close
            const closeBtn = bar.querySelector('.flash-close');
            if (closeBtn) {
                closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { dismissBar(bar); });
            }

            // Auto-dismiss after DISMISS_AFTER ms
            const timer = setTimeout(function () { dismissBar(bar); }, DISMISS_AFTER);

            // Pause on hover — restart timer on leave
            bar.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { clearTimeout(timer); });
            bar.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
                setTimeout(function () { dismissBar(bar); }, 800);
            });
        });
    })();
    </script>

{% block extra_js %}
<script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='js/admin/admin_report.js') }}"></script>
<script nonce="{{ csp_nonce() }}">
const G='#52B788', T='#00a8cc', A='#f59e0b', R='#ef4444', P='#7c3aed', S='#94a3b8';
const mo=['Oct','Nov','Dec','Jan','Feb','Mar'];
const ch={};

function kill(id){ if(ch[id]){ ch[id].destroy(); delete ch[id]; } }

function leg(id,items){
    const el=document.getElementById(id);
    if(!el) return;
    el.innerHTML=items.map(i=>`
        <span class="legend-item">
            <span class="legend-dot" style="background:${i.c}"></span>
            ${i.l}${i.p ? ' ('+i.p+'%)' : ''}
        </span>`).join('');
}

function renderCharts(){
    const activeBtn = document.querySelector('.tab-btn.active');
    if(!activeBtn) return;
    const tab = activeBtn.dataset.tab;

    if(tab==='sales'){
        kill('revenue'); kill('category');
        ch['revenue']=new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-revenue'),{
            type:'bar',
            data:{
                labels:mo,
                datasets:[
                    {label:'Sales', data:[310000,340000,295000,380000,410000,428500], backgroundColor:G+'CC', borderRadius:6},
                    {label:'Target', data:[350000,350000,350000,360000,390000,410000], type:'line', borderColor:T, tension:0.4, borderWidth:2}
                ]
            },
            options:{ responsive:true, maintainAspectRatio:false, plugins:{legend:{display:false}}, scales:{y:{ticks:{callback:v=>'?'+(v/1000)+'k'}}}}
        });
        const cD=[45,28,18,9], cC=[G,T,A,R], cL=['Respiratory','Mobility','Monitoring','Other'];
        ch['category']=new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-category'),{type:'doughnut',data:{labels:cL,datasets:[{data:cD,backgroundColor:cC,borderWidth:0}]},options:{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false,plugins:{legend:{display:false}},cutout:'65%'}});
        leg('legend-category', cL.map((l,i)=>({c:cC[i],l,p:cD[i]})));
    }

    if(tab==='rentals'){
        kill('rental-volume'); kill('rental-status');
        ch['rental-volume']=new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-rental-volume'),{type:'bar',data:{labels:mo,datasets:[{label:'Rentals',data:[38,42,35,44,46,48],backgroundColor:T+'CC',borderRadius:6}]},options:{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false,plugins:{legend:{display:false}}}});
        const rD=[48,6,12], rC=[G,R,A], rL=['Active','Overdue','Returned'];
        ch['rental-status']=new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-rental-status'),{type:'doughnut',data:{labels:rL,datasets:[{data:rD,backgroundColor:rC,borderWidth:0}]},options:{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false,plugins:{legend:{display:false}},cutout:'65%'}});
        leg('legend-rental-status', rL.map((l,i)=>({c:rC[i],l,p:rD[i]})));
    }

    if(tab==='inventory'){
        kill('stock');
        ch['stock']=new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-stock'),{type:'bar',data:{labels:['Respi','Mobil','Monit','Beds','Other'],datasets:[{label:'Stock',data:[420,188,310,42,244],backgroundColor:G+'CC',borderRadius:6}]},options:{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false}});
    }

    if(tab==='customers'){
        kill('customer-growth'); kill('customer-type');
        ch['customer-growth']=new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-customer-growth'),{type:'line',data:{labels:mo,datasets:[{label:'New',data:[22,28,19,32,35,38],borderColor:G,backgroundColor:G+'22',fill:true,tension:0.4}]},options:{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false}});
        const ctD=[538,304], ctC=[G,T], ctL=['Returning','New'];
        ch['customer-type']=new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-customer-type'),{type:'doughnut',data:{labels:ctL,datasets:[{data:ctD,backgroundColor:ctC,borderWidth:0}]},options:{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false,plugins:{legend:{display:false}},cutout:'65%'}});
        leg('legend-customer-type', ctL.map((l,i)=>({c:ctC[i],l,p:Math.round(ctD[i]/842*100)})));
    }

    if(tab==='financial'){
        kill('cashflow'); kill('expenses');
        ch['cashflow']=new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-cashflow'),{type:'bar',data:{labels:mo,datasets:[{label:'Rev',data:[520,560,490,580,600,610],backgroundColor:G+'BB'},{label:'Exp',data:[110,130,105,125,138,142],backgroundColor:R+'BB'}]},options:{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false}});
        const eD=[38,26,18,12,6], eC=[A,R,T,P,S], eL=['Supplies','Maint','Utils','Staff','Other'];
        ch['expenses']=new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-expenses'),{type:'doughnut',data:{labels:eL,datasets:[{data:eD,backgroundColor:eC,borderWidth:0}]},options:{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false,plugins:{legend:{display:false}},cutout:'65%'}});
        leg('legend-expenses', eL.map((l,i)=>({c:eC[i],l,p:eD[i]})));
    }
}

document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));

{% block extra_js %}
<script nonce="{{ csp_nonce() }}">
(function () {
    const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').getAttribute('content');

    // Filter buttons
    function applyFilter(type, activeBtn) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.fbtn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        activeBtn.classList.add('active');
        document.querySelectorAll('.log-row').forEach(row => {
            const ev  = (row.dataset.event || '').toLowerCase();
            const sus = row.dataset.suspicious === 'true';
            let show  = false;
            if      (type === 'all')        show = true;
            else if (type === 'suspicious') show = sus;
            else if (type === 'failed')     show = ev.includes('failed') || ev.includes('wrong password') || ev.includes('unknown email');
            else if (type === 'locked')     show = ev.includes('lockout') || ev.includes('locked') || ev.includes('lock');
            else if (type === 'rate')       show = ev.includes('rate');
            else if (type === 'blocked')    show = ev.includes('block');
            else if (type === 'bot')        show = ev.includes('bot detected');
            row.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
        });
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.fbtn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            applyFilter(this.dataset.filter, this);
        });
    });

    // Delete individual log
    const logBody = document.getElementById('logBody');
    if (logBody) {
        logBody.addEventListener('click', async function (e) {
            const btn = e.target.closest('.log-delete-btn');
            if (!btn) return;
            if (!confirm('Delete this log entry?')) return;
            const logId = btn.dataset.logId;
            try {
                const res  = await fetch('/admin/security/delete-log/' + logId, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken }
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    btn.closest('tr').remove();
                } else {
                    alert('Failed to delete log: ' + (data.message || 'Unknown error'));
                }
            } catch (err) {
                alert('Network error while deleting log.');
            }
        });
    }

    // Clear all logs
    const clearForm = document.getElementById('clearLogsForm');
    if (clearForm) {
        clearForm.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
            if (!confirm('Clear ALL logs? This cannot be undone.')) {
                e.preventDefault();
            }
        });
    }

    // Unblock IP confirm
    document.querySelectorAll('.unblock-form').forEach(form => {
        form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
            if (!confirm('Unblock this IP address?')) {
                e.preventDefault();
            }
        });
    });

    // Auto-refresh every 30 seconds
    setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 30000);
})();
</script>
{% endblock %}

                    <span class="btn-text">Send Reset Link</span>
                    <div class="spinner" id="btnSpinner" style="display: none;"></div>
                </button>
                
                <p class="footer-note" style="margin-top: 20px;">
                    Remember your password? <a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="closeForgotModal()">Back to Login</a>
                </p>

    <script nonce="{{ csp_nonce() }}">
        const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').getAttribute('content');

        // --- Modal Functions ---
        function openForgotModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('forgotPasswordModal');
            if (modal) {
                modal.style.display = 'flex';
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            }
        }

        function closeForgotModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('forgotPasswordModal');
            if (modal) {
                modal.style.display = 'none';
                document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
            }
        }

        function showModalMessage(message, isSuccess) {
            const container = document.getElementById('modal-flash-container');
            if (!container) return;
            container.textContent = message;
            container.style.display = 'block';
            container.style.backgroundColor = isSuccess ? "#ecfdf5" : "#fef2f2";
            container.style.color = isSuccess ? "#065f46" : "#991b1b";
            container.style.border = isSuccess ? "1px solid #10b981" : "1px solid #ef4444";
        }

        // --- Reset Link Logic ---
        async function handleSendResetLink() {
            const emailInput = document.getElementById('resetEmail');
            const btn = document.getElementById('sendLinkBtn');
            const spinner = document.getElementById('btnSpinner');
            const btnText = btn.querySelector('.btn-text');

            if (!emailInput.value) {
                showModalMessage("Please enter your email address.", false);
                return;
            }

            btn.disabled = true;
            if (spinner) spinner.style.display = 'inline-block';
            if (btnText) btnText.style.opacity = '0.5';

            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('email', emailInput.value);

            try {
                const response = await fetch("{{ url_for('auth.send_reset_link') }}", {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { "X-CSRFToken": csrfToken },
                    body: formData
                });
                const data = await response.json();
                showModalMessage(data.message, data.success);
                if (data.success) emailInput.value = '';
            } catch (error) {
                showModalMessage("Connection error. Try again.", false);
            } finally {
                btn.disabled = false;
                if (spinner) spinner.style.display = 'none';
                if (btnText) btnText.style.opacity = '1';
            }
        }

        // --- Main Initializer (Where the magic happens) ---
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            
            // 1. Forgot Password Click
            const forgotLink = document.getElementById('forgotPasswordLink');
            if (forgotLink) {
                forgotLink.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    openForgotModal();
                });
            }

            // 2. Close Modal Buttons (The X and the "Back to Login" link)
            const closeSelectors = ['#closeModalBtn', '#backToLoginLink'];
            closeSelectors.forEach(selector => {
                const el = document.querySelector(selector);
                if (el) el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    closeForgotModal();
                });
            });

            // 3. Send Reset Link Button
            const sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendLinkBtn');
            if (sendBtn) {
                sendBtn.addEventListener('click', handleSendResetLink);
            }

            // 4. Password Visibility Toggle
            const toggleIcons = document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-pass');
            toggleIcons.forEach(icon => {
                icon.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    const passwordInput = this.parentElement.querySelector('input');
                    if (passwordInput.type === 'password') {
                        passwordInput.type = 'text';
                        this.classList.replace('fa-eye-slash', 'fa-eye');
                    } else {
                        passwordInput.type = 'password';
                        this.classList.replace('fa-eye', 'fa-eye-slash');
                    }
                });
            });

            // 5. Close modal if clicking outside the box
            const modalOverlay = document.getElementById('forgotPasswordModal');
            if (modalOverlay) {
                modalOverlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    if (e.target === modalOverlay) closeForgotModal();
                });
            }
        });

        setTimeout(() => {
            const alerts = document.querySelectorAll('.alert');
            alerts.forEach(alert => {
                alert.style.transition = "opacity 0.5s ease";
                alert.style.opacity = "0";
                setTimeout(() => alert.remove(), 500);
            });
        }, 5000);

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Check if a rate limit message exists on the page
            const rateLimitBox = document.querySelector('.rate-limit-msg');
            const loginBtn = document.querySelector('#loginForm .btn-primary');

            if (rateLimitBox && loginBtn) {
                // Disable button visually and functionally for a few seconds
                loginBtn.disabled = true;
                loginBtn.style.opacity = "0.6";
                loginBtn.style.cursor = "not-allowed";
                loginBtn.value = "Please wait...";

                // Re-enable after 5 seconds to let them try once the cool-down is likely over
                setTimeout(() => {
                    loginBtn.disabled = false;
                    loginBtn.style.opacity = "1";
                    loginBtn.style.cursor = "pointer";
                    loginBtn.value = "Login";
                }, 5000);
            }
        });
    </script>

</body>

</html>

    const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').getAttribute('content');

    function showModalMessage(message, isSuccess) {
        const container = document.getElementById('modal-flash-container');
        if (!container) return;
        container.textContent = message;
        container.style.display = 'block';
        container.style.backgroundColor = isSuccess ? "#ecfdf5" : "#fef2f2";
        container.style.color = isSuccess ? "#065f46" : "#991b1b";
        container.style.border = isSuccess ? "1px solid #10b981" : "1px solid #ef4444";
    }

    // --- Main Initializer ---
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

        // 2. Password Visibility Toggle (Works for all forms)
        const toggleIcons = document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-pass');
        toggleIcons.forEach(icon => {
            icon.addEventListener('click', function () {
                const passwordInput = this.parentElement.querySelector('input');
                if (passwordInput.type === 'password') {
                    passwordInput.type = 'text';
                    this.classList.remove('fa-eye-slash');
                    this.classList.add('fa-eye');
                } else {
                    passwordInput.type = 'password';
                    this.classList.remove('fa-eye');
                    this.classList.add('fa-eye-slash');
                }
            });
        });

        // 7. URL Parameter logic (Show Signup)
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        if (urlParams.get('show_signup') === '1') {
            if (typeof toggleForms === 'function') {
                toggleForms();
            }
            const newURL = window.location.href.split('?')[0];
            window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, newURL);
        }

        // 8. Registration Password Matching Logic
        const regPass = document.getElementById('reg_password');
        const regConfirmPass = document.getElementById('reg_confirm_password');
        const regMatchMsg = document.getElementById('reg-match-message');
        const regBtn = document.getElementById('regBtn');

        if (regPass && regConfirmPass) {
            function validateRegistrationMatch() {
                if (regConfirmPass.value.length === 0) {
                    regMatchMsg.textContent = "";
                    regBtn.disabled = false;
                    return;
                }

                if (regPass.value === regConfirmPass.value) {
                    regMatchMsg.textContent = "? Passwords match";
                    regMatchMsg.style.color = "#10b981";
                    regBtn.disabled = false;
                    regBtn.style.opacity = "1";
                    regBtn.style.cursor = "pointer";
                } else {
                    regMatchMsg.textContent = "? Passwords do not match";
                    regMatchMsg.style.color = "#ef4444";
                    regBtn.disabled = true;
                    regBtn.style.opacity = "0.7";
                    regBtn.style.cursor = "not-allowed";
                }
            }

            regPass.addEventListener('keyup', validateRegistrationMatch);
            regConfirmPass.addEventListener('keyup', validateRegistrationMatch);
        }

        // 9. Handle Form Submission UI
        const registerForm = document.getElementById('registerForm');
        if (registerForm && regBtn) {
            registerForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
                // Prevent double submission if already loading
                if (regBtn.classList.contains('is-loading')) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    return;
                }

                // 1. Store the original text to restore it later if needed
                const originalText = regBtn.innerHTML;

                // 2. Add loading state and inject spinner
                regBtn.classList.add('is-loading');
                regBtn.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="spinner"></div>
                    <span>Creating Account...</span>
                `;
                
                // 3. Disable the button after a tiny delay for rendering
                setTimeout(() => {
                    regBtn.disabled = true;
                }, 10);

                // 4. Safety Timeout (10 Seconds)
                // If the server doesn't respond or the page doesn't change, reset the button
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (regBtn.classList.contains('is-loading')) {
                        regBtn.disabled = false;
                        regBtn.classList.remove('is-loading');
                        regBtn.innerHTML = originalText;
                        
                        // Optional: Show an error message if the server is ghosting
                        showModalMessage("Connection timed out. Please try again.", false);
                    }
                }, 10000); // 10,000ms = 10 seconds
            });
        }
            });
</script>

                            {{ form.password(id="newPassword", placeholder="••••••••", autocomplete="new-password") }}
                           <i class="fa-solid fa-eye-slash toggle-pass" style="cursor: pointer;" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Toggle password visibility"></i>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div class="password-requirements" aria-live="polite" style="margin-top: 15px; text-align: left;">
                            <div id="req-length" class="req" data-label="8+ characters" style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #6b7280; margin-bottom: 4px;">? 8+ characters</div>
                            <div id="req-upper" class="req" data-label="One uppercase letter" style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #6b7280; margin-bottom: 4px;">? One uppercase letter</div>
                            <div id="req-number" class="req" data-label="One number" style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #6b7280; margin-bottom: 4px;">? One number</div>
                            <div id="req-special" class="req" data-label="One special character" style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #6b7280;">? One special character</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="input-field" style="margin-top: 20px;">
                        <label for="confirmPassword">Confirm New Password</label>
                        <div class="input-group">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-lock"></i>
                            {{ form.confirm_password(id="confirmPassword", placeholder="••••••••", autocomplete="off") }}
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-eye-slash toggle-pass" style="cursor: pointer;" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Toggle password visibility"></i>
                        </div>
                        <div id="match-message" aria-live="polite" style="font-size: 0.8rem; margin-top: 8px; min-height: 1rem; font-weight: 600;"></div>
                    </div>

                    <button type="submit" class="btn-primary" id="updateBtn" style="margin-top: 20px; opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed;" disabled>
                        Update Password
                    </button>

    <script nonce="{{ csp_nonce() }}">
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const newPass = document.getElementById('newPassword');
            const confirmPass = document.getElementById('confirmPassword');
            const updateBtn = document.getElementById('updateBtn');
            const matchMsg = document.getElementById('match-message');

            const reqs = {
                length: { el: document.getElementById('req-length'), regex: /.{8,}/ },
                upper: { el: document.getElementById('req-upper'), regex: /[A-Z]/ },
                number: { el: document.getElementById('req-number'), regex: /\d/ },
                special: { el: document.getElementById('req-special'), regex: /[!@#$%^&*(),.?":{}|<>]/ }
            };

            // Toggle Password Visibility
            document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-pass').forEach(icon => {
                icon.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    const input = this.parentElement.querySelector('input');
                    if (input.type === 'password') {
                        input.type = 'text';
                        this.classList.replace('fa-eye-slash', 'fa-eye');
                    } else {
                        input.type = 'password';
                        this.classList.replace('fa-eye', 'fa-eye-slash');
                    }
                });
            });

            const validate = () => {
                const val = newPass.value;
                let isAllValid = true;

                // 1. Validate Password Strength Requirements
                Object.keys(reqs).forEach(key => {
                    const item = reqs[key];
                    const isValid = item.regex.test(val);
                    const label = item.el.getAttribute('data-label');

                    if (isValid) {
                        item.el.style.color = "#10b981"; // Green
                        item.el.textContent = "? " + label;
                    } else if (val.length > 0) {
                        item.el.style.color = "#ef4444"; // Red
                        item.el.textContent = "? " + label;
                        isAllValid = false;
                    } else {
                        item.el.style.color = "#6b7280"; // Gray
                        item.el.textContent = "? " + label;
                        isAllValid = false;
                    }
                });

                // 2. Check if Passwords Match
                const confirmVal = confirmPass.value;
                if (confirmVal.length > 0) {
                    if (val === confirmVal) {
                        matchMsg.textContent = "? Passwords match";
                        matchMsg.style.color = "#10b981";
                    } else {
                        matchMsg.textContent = "? Passwords do not match";
                        matchMsg.style.color = "#ef4444";
                    }
                } else {
                    matchMsg.textContent = "";
                }

                // 3. Enable/Disable Button
                const passwordsMatch = (val === confirmVal && val.length > 0);
                if (isAllValid && passwordsMatch) {
                    updateBtn.disabled = false;
                    updateBtn.style.opacity = "1";
                    updateBtn.style.cursor = "pointer";
                } else {
                    updateBtn.disabled = true;
                    updateBtn.style.opacity = "0.6";
                    updateBtn.style.cursor = "not-allowed";
                }
            };

            newPass.addEventListener('input', validate);
            confirmPass.addEventListener('input', validate);
        });
    </script>

    <script nonce="{{ csp_nonce() }}">
        const WAIT_SECONDS = 300;
        const storageKey = 'ratelimit_active';

        // Only set a new start time if there's no existing active countdown
        // or if the previous one has already expired
        const existing = sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey);
        if (existing) {
            const data = JSON.parse(existing);
            const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - data.start) / 1000);
            if (elapsed >= WAIT_SECONDS) {
                // Previous countdown already finished — start fresh
                sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify({ start: Date.now() }));
            }
            // else: still valid, keep existing start time
        } else {
            // No existing countdown — start fresh
            sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify({ start: Date.now() }));
        }

        const data = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey));
        const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - data.start) / 1000);
        let seconds = Math.max(0, WAIT_SECONDS - elapsed);

        const countdownEl = document.getElementById('countdown');
        const countdownText = document.getElementById('countdown-text');
        const backBtn = document.getElementById('back-btn');

        if (seconds <= 0) {
            countdownText.style.display = 'none';
            backBtn.classList.add('visible');
            sessionStorage.removeItem(storageKey);
        } else {
            countdownEl.textContent = seconds;
            const timer = setInterval(function() {
                seconds--;
                countdownEl.textContent = seconds;
                if (seconds <= 0) {
                    clearInterval(timer);
                    countdownText.style.display = 'none';
                    backBtn.classList.add('visible');
                    sessionStorage.removeItem(storageKey);
                }
            }, 1000);

    <script nonce="{{ csp_nonce() }}">
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

            // --- 1. Dropdown Toggle Logic ---
            const profileTrigger = document.getElementById("profileTrigger");
            const profileMenu = document.getElementById("dropdownMenu");

            if (profileTrigger && profileMenu) {
                profileTrigger.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    profileMenu.classList.toggle("show");
                });
            }

            // --- 2. Intersection Observer for Navigation ---
            const aboutSection = document.querySelector('#about');
            const aboutNavLink = document.querySelector('a[href="#about"]');
            const observerOptions = { root: null, threshold: 0.6 };

            const navObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (aboutNavLink) {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            aboutNavLink.classList.add('active-link');
                        } else {
                            aboutNavLink.classList.remove('active-link');
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, observerOptions);

            if (aboutSection) navObserver.observe(aboutSection);

            // --- 3. Auth State UI Management ---
            if (document.body.classList.contains("logged-in")) {
                document.querySelectorAll(".guest-only").forEach(el => el.style.display = "none");
            } else {
                document.querySelectorAll(".auth-only").forEach(el => el.style.display = "none");
            }

            // --- 4. Profile Image Fallback ---
            const profileImages = document.querySelectorAll('.user-photo-img');
            profileImages.forEach(img => {
                img.onerror = function() {
                    const container = this.parentElement;
                    container.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined icon-placeholder">account_circle</span>';
                    const placeholder = container.querySelector('.icon-placeholder');
                    placeholder.style.fontSize = container.classList.contains('profile-avatar-large') ? "100px" : "38px";
                };
            });

            // --- 5. Address Modal Logic ---
            const addrModal = document.getElementById('addressModal');
            const openAddrBtn = document.getElementById('openAddrModal');
            const closeAddrBtn = document.getElementById('closeAddrModal');
            const cancelAddrBtn = document.getElementById('cancelAddrModal');

            const openAddrFunc = () => {
                if (addrModal) {
                    addrModal.style.display = 'flex';
                    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                }
            };

            const closeAddrFunc = () => {
                if (addrModal) {
                    addrModal.style.display = 'none';
                    document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
                }
            };

            if (openAddrBtn) openAddrBtn.addEventListener('click', openAddrFunc);
            if (closeAddrBtn) closeAddrBtn.addEventListener('click', closeAddrFunc);
            if (cancelAddrBtn) cancelAddrBtn.addEventListener('click', closeAddrFunc);

            // --- 6. ID Upload Modal Logic ---
            const uploadModal = document.getElementById('idUploadModal'); 
            const openUploadBtn = document.getElementById('openUploadModal');
            const closeUploadBtn = document.getElementById('closeIdUploadModal');

            // ===== RESET FORM =====
            const resetIdUploadForm = () => {
                const primaryType = document.querySelector('[name="primary_id_type"]');
                const secondaryType = document.querySelector('[name="secondary_id_type"]');
                const primaryFile = document.getElementById('id_primary');
                const secondaryFile = document.getElementById('id_secondary');

                const primaryText = document.getElementById('file-name-primary');
                const secondaryText = document.getElementById('file-name-secondary');

                const primaryWarn = document.getElementById('primary-warning');
                const secondaryWarn = document.getElementById('secondary-warning');

                if (primaryType) primaryType.selectedIndex = 0;
                if (secondaryType) secondaryType.selectedIndex = 0;

                if (primaryFile) primaryFile.value = "";
                if (secondaryFile) secondaryFile.value = "";

                if (primaryText) primaryText.textContent = "No file chosen";
                if (secondaryText) secondaryText.textContent = "No file chosen";

                if (primaryWarn) primaryWarn.style.display = "none";
                if (secondaryWarn) secondaryWarn.style.display = "none";
            };

            const focusIdForm = () => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    document.querySelector('[name="primary_id_type"]')?.focus();
                }, 200);
            };

            const openUploadFunc = () => {
                if (uploadModal) {
                    uploadModal.style.display = 'flex';
                    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                    focusIdForm();
                }
            };

            const closeUploadFunc = () => {
                if (uploadModal) {
                    uploadModal.style.display = 'none';
                    document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
                    resetIdUploadForm();
                }
            };

            if (openUploadBtn) openUploadBtn.addEventListener('click', openUploadFunc);
            if (closeUploadBtn) closeUploadBtn.onclick = closeUploadFunc;

            // --- 7. FILE INPUT DISPLAY ---
            const setupFileUpload = (inputId, textId) => {
                const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
                const text = document.getElementById(textId);

                if (!input || !text) return;

                input.addEventListener('change', function() {
                    if (this.files && this.files.length > 0) {
                        text.textContent = this.files[0].name;
                        text.style.color = "#0d9488";
                    } else {
                        text.textContent = "No file chosen";
                        text.style.color = "#1e3a5f";
                    }
                });
            };

            setupFileUpload('id_primary', 'file-name-primary');
            setupFileUpload('id_secondary', 'file-name-secondary');

            // --- 8. REAL-TIME VALIDATION (NEW FEATURE) ---
            const primaryType = document.querySelector('[name="primary_id_type"]');
            const secondaryType = document.querySelector('[name="secondary_id_type"]');
            const primaryFile = document.getElementById('id_primary');
            const secondaryFile = document.getElementById('id_secondary');

            const primaryWarn = document.getElementById('primary-warning');
            const secondaryWarn = document.getElementById('secondary-warning');

            function validatePrimary() {
                if (!primaryType || !primaryFile) return;

                if (primaryType.value && primaryFile.files.length === 0) {
                    primaryWarn.style.display = "block";
                } else {
                    primaryWarn.style.display = "none";
                }
            }

            function validateSecondary() {
                if (!secondaryType || !secondaryFile) return;

                if (secondaryType.value && secondaryFile.files.length === 0) {
                    secondaryWarn.style.display = "block";
                } else {
                    secondaryWarn.style.display = "none";
                }
            }

            if (primaryType) {
                primaryType.addEventListener('change', validatePrimary);
            }
            if (primaryFile) {
                primaryFile.addEventListener('change', validatePrimary);
            }

            if (secondaryType) {
                secondaryType.addEventListener('change', validateSecondary);
            }
            if (secondaryFile) {
                secondaryFile.addEventListener('change', validateSecondary);
            }

        });

        document.getElementById('checkout-form').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {

            const hasRental = {{ 'true' if has_rental else 'false' }};

            const primaryType = document.querySelector('[name="primary_id_type"]')?.value;
            const secondaryType = document.querySelector('[name="secondary_id_type"]')?.value;

            const primaryFile = document.getElementById('id_primary')?.files?.length || 0;
            const secondaryFile = document.getElementById('id_secondary')?.files?.length || 0;

            let errors = [];

            const primaryIdPath = "{{ current_user.customer_profile.valid_id_path or '' }}".trim();
            const secondaryIdPath = "{{ current_user.customer_profile.secondary_id_path or '' }}".trim();

            const hasExistingIds = primaryIdPath && secondaryIdPath;

            if (hasRental && !hasExistingIds) {
                e.preventDefault();

                const modal = document.getElementById('idUploadModal');

                const openModal = () => {
                    if (modal) {
                        modal.style.display = 'flex';
                        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                    }
                };

                // --- SweetAlert flow (preferred) ---
                if (typeof Swal !== 'undefined') {
                    Swal.fire({
                        title: 'Identity Verification Required',
                        text: 'You must upload 2 valid IDs before placing a rental order.',
                        icon: 'warning',
                        confirmButtonText: 'Proceed to Upload',
                        allowOutsideClick: false
                    }).then(() => {
                        openModal();
                    });

                } else {
                    // fallback alert
                    alert("You must upload 2 valid IDs before placing a rental order.");
                    openModal();
                }

                return false;
            }

            if (primaryType && !primaryFile) {
                errors.push("Primary ID selected but no file uploaded.");
            }

            if (secondaryType && !secondaryFile) {
                errors.push("Secondary ID selected but no file uploaded.");
            }

            if (!primaryType && primaryFile) {
                errors.push("Primary file uploaded but ID type not selected.");
            }

            if (!secondaryType && secondaryFile) {
                errors.push("Secondary file uploaded but ID type not selected.");
            }

            if (errors.length > 0) {
                e.preventDefault();

                if (typeof Swal !== 'undefined') {
                    Swal.fire({
                        icon: 'warning',
                        title: 'Missing ID Information',
                        html: errors.join('<br>')
                    });
                } else {
                    alert(errors.join("\n"));
                }

                return false;
            }
            

        });

        document.querySelectorAll('input[name="payment_method"]').forEach((elem) => {
            elem.addEventListener("change", function(event) {
                const btn = document.querySelector('.place-order-btn');
                if (event.target.value === 'GCASH') {
                    btn.innerHTML = 'Proceed to Payment <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i>';
                } else {
                    btn.innerHTML = 'Place Order <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i>';
                }
            });
        });
    </script>

                                    {# ==========================================
                                    CORE TRACKING LOGIC 
                                    ========================================== #}
                                    {% set state = order.tracking_stage %}
                                    {% set steps_list = ['SUBMITTED', 'VERIFYING', 'SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED'] %}

                                    {# Assign numeric index to current state #}
                                    {% set current_index = 0 %}
                                    {% if state == 'VERIFIED' %}{% set current_index = 1 %}
                                    {% elif state == 'SHIPPED' %}{% set current_index = 2 %}
                                    {% elif state == 'DELIVERED' %}{% set current_index = 3 %}
                                    {% endif %}

                                    <div class="progress-container" style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; position: relative; z-index: 3; padding: 0 10px; margin-top: 20px;">

                                        {% for step_name in steps_list %}
                                            {% set i = loop.index0 %}

                                            {# Define defaults #}
                                            {% set is_green = false %}
                                            {% set is_orange = false %}
                                            {% set is_pulse = false %}
                                            {% set line_color = '#e2e8f0' %}

                                            {# Logic for Icons #}
                                            {% if i <= current_index %}
                                                {# Current and finished icons are green #}
                                                {% set is_green = true %}
                                            {% elif i == current_index + 1 %}
                                                {# The very next icon is orange + pulse #}
                                                {% set is_orange = true %}
                                                {% set is_pulse = true %}
                                            {% endif %}

                                            {# Logic for Lines #}
                                            {% if i < current_index %}
                                                {# Lines between completed steps are green #}
                                                {% set line_color = '#22c55e' %} 
                                            {% elif i == current_index %}
                                                {% if state == 'DELIVERED' %}
                                                    {% set line_color = '#22c55e' %}
                                                {% else %}
                                                    {# The line to the right of the current step is orange #}
                                                    {% set line_color = '#f97316' %} 
                                                {% endif %}
                                            {% endif %}

                                            {# Delivered state override: no pulse #}
                                            {% if state == 'DELIVERED' %}
                                                {% set is_pulse = false %}
                                            {% endif %}

                                            {# Determine the CSS background color #}
                                            {% set step_bg = '#e2e8f0' %}
                                            {% if is_green %}{% set step_bg = '#22c55e' %}
                                            {% elif is_orange %}{% set step_bg = '#f97316' %}
                                            {% endif %}

                                            <div class="track-step" style="text-align: center; flex: 1; position: relative;">

                                                {# THE LINE ELEMENT #}
                                                {% if not loop.last %}
                                                    <div class="step-line"
                                                        style="position: absolute; top: 16px; left: 50%; width: 100%; height: 3px;
                                                                background: {{ line_color }};
                                                                z-index: -1; transition: background 0.4s ease;">
                                                    </div>
                                                {% endif %}

                                                {# THE ICON ELEMENT #}
                                                <div class="step-icon {% if is_pulse %}is-current{% endif %}"
                                                    style="width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%;
                                                            background: {{ step_bg }};
                                                            color: white;
                                                            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
                                                            margin: 0 auto 10px; border: 3px solid #fff;
                                                            box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px {{ step_bg }};
                                                            transition: all 0.4s ease; position: relative; z-index: 2;">

                                                    {% if step_name == 'SUBMITTED' %}<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>
                                                    {% elif step_name == 'VERIFYING' %}<i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass"></i>
                                                    {% elif step_name == 'SHIPPING' %}<i class="fa-solid fa-truck-fast"></i>
                                                    {% elif step_name == 'DELIVERED' %}<i class="fa-solid fa-house-medical"></i>
                                                    {% endif %}
                                                </div>

                                                {# STEP LABEL #}
                                                <span style="display: block; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700;
                                                            color: {{ '#1e293b' if is_green else '#94a3b8' }};
                                                            text-transform: uppercase;">
                                                    {{ step_name }}
                                                </span>
                                            </div>
                                        {% endfor %}
                                    </div>

    <script nonce="{{ csp_nonce() }}">
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
                        // Dropdown toggle
            const trigger = document.getElementById("profileTrigger");
            const menu = document.getElementById("dropdownMenu");

            if (trigger && menu) {
                trigger.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    menu.classList.toggle("show");
                });
            }

            // Close dropdown when clicking outside
            window.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
                if (!event.target.closest(".user-profile-widget")) {
                    const dropdowns = document.getElementsByClassName("dropdown-menu");
                    for (let i = 0; i < dropdowns.length; i++) {
                        let openDropdown = dropdowns[i];
                        if (openDropdown.classList.contains("show")) {
                            openDropdown.classList.remove("show");
                        }
                    }
                }
            });

            // About section IntersectionObserver
            const aboutSection = document.querySelector('#about');
            const aboutNavLink = document.querySelector('a[href="#about"]');

            const observerOptions = {
                root: null,
                threshold: 0.6
            };

            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        aboutNavLink.classList.add('active-link');
                    } else {
                        aboutNavLink.classList.remove('active-link');
                    }
                });
            }, observerOptions);

            if (aboutSection) {
                observer.observe(aboutSection);
            }

            // Show/hide elements based on auth state
            if (document.body.classList.contains("logged-in")) {
                document.querySelectorAll(".guest-only").forEach(el => el.style.display = "none");
            } else {
                document.querySelectorAll(".auth-only").forEach(el => el.style.display = "none");
            }

            // Profile image fallback
            const profileImages = document.querySelectorAll('.user-photo-img');

            profileImages.forEach(img => {
                img.onerror = function() {
                    const container = this.parentElement;
                    container.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined icon-placeholder">account_circle</span>';
                    const placeholder = container.querySelector('.icon-placeholder');
                    if (container.classList.contains('profile-avatar-large')) {
                        placeholder.style.fontSize = "100px";
                    } else {
                        placeholder.style.fontSize = "38px";
                    }
                };
            });

            const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');
            const tabContents = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content');

            // 1. Function to handle Tab Switching
            function switchTab(tabName) {
                // Hide all contents
                tabContents.forEach(content => {
                    content.style.display = "none";
                    content.classList.remove("active");
                });

                // Deactivate all buttons
                tabButtons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove("active"));

                // Show target content and activate button
                const targetContent = document.getElementById(tabName);
                const targetBtn = document.querySelector(`[data-target="${tabName}"]`);

                if (targetContent && targetBtn) {
                    targetContent.style.display = "block";
                    targetContent.classList.add("active");
                    targetBtn.classList.add("active");
                }
            }

            // 2. Attach Event Listeners to Buttons (Fixes the "Inline Event Handler" error)
            tabButtons.forEach(button => {
                button.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    const target = this.getAttribute('data-target');
                    switchTab(target);
                });
            });

            // 3. Handle URL parameters (e.g., ?tab=rentals)
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const targetTab = urlParams.get('tab');

            if (targetTab === 'rentals') {
                switchTab('rentals');
            } else {
                switchTab('orders'); // Default
            }
        });
    </script>
   
    
</body>

        if (searchInput) {
            searchInput.addEventListener('input', function (e) {

                const products = document.querySelectorAll('.product-card');
                products.forEach(product => {
                    const name = product.getAttribute('data-name').toLowerCase();
                    product.style.display = name.includes(term) ? 'flex' : 'none';
                });

            console.log(action + " clicked for " + product);

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

            const trigger = document.getElementById("profileTrigger");
            const menu = document.getElementById("dropdownMenu");

            if (trigger && menu) {
                trigger.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    menu.classList.toggle("show");
                });
            }

            window.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
                if (!event.target.closest(".user-profile-widget")) {
                    const dropdowns = document.getElementsByClassName("dropdown-menu");
                    for (let i = 0; i < dropdowns.length; i++) {
                        let openDropdown = dropdowns[i];
                        if (openDropdown.classList.contains("show")) {
                            openDropdown.classList.remove("show");
                        }
                    }
                }
            });

            const aboutSection = document.querySelector('#about');
            const aboutNavLinks = document.querySelectorAll('a[href="#about"]');

            const howSection = document.querySelector('#how');
            const howNavLinks = document.querySelectorAll('a[href="#how"]');

            const observerOptions = { root: null, threshold: 0.6 };

            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {

                    if (entry.target.id === 'about') {
                        aboutNavLinks.forEach(link => {
                            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                                link.classList.add('active-link');
                            } else {
                                link.classList.remove('active-link');
                            }
                        });
                    }

                    if (entry.target.id === 'how') {
                        howNavLinks.forEach(link => {
                            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                                link.classList.add('active-link');
                            } else {
                                link.classList.remove('active-link');
                            }
                        });
                    }

                });
            }, observerOptions);

            if (aboutSection) observer.observe(aboutSection);
            if (howSection) observer.observe(howSection);

            if (document.body.classList.contains("logged-in")) {
                document.querySelectorAll(".guest-only").forEach(el => el.style.display = "none");
            } else {
                document.querySelectorAll(".auth-only").forEach(el => el.style.display = "none");
            }

            const profileImages = document.querySelectorAll('.user-photo-img');
            profileImages.forEach(img => {
                img.onerror = function() {
                    const container = this.parentElement;
                    container.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined icon-placeholder">account_circle</span>';
                    const placeholder = container.querySelector('.icon-placeholder');
                    placeholder.style.fontSize = container.classList.contains('profile-avatar-large') ? "100px" : "38px";
                };
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>
